description: NaSmS₂ is Caswellsilverite structured and crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3m space group. Na¹⁺ is bonded to six equivalent S²⁻ atoms to form NaS₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SmS₆ octahedra, edges with six equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, and edges with six equivalent SmS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 4°. All Na-S bond lengths are 2.93 Å. Sm³⁺ is bonded to six equivalent S²⁻ atoms to form SmS₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, edges with six equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, and edges with six equivalent SmS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 4°. All Sm-S bond lengths are 2.81 Å. S²⁻ is bonded to three equivalent Na¹⁺ and three equivalent Sm³⁺ atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SNa₃Sm₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted.
